verses.en: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king’s son.
verses.pt: Deus, dá teus juízos ao rei, e tua justiça ao filho do rei.
verses.en_web: God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.
verses.en_bbe: <Of Solomon.> Give the king your authority, O God, and your righteousness to the king's son.

verses.en: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.
verses.pt: Ele julgará a teu povo com justiça, e a teus aflitos com juízo.
verses.en_web: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
verses.en_bbe: May he be a judge of your people in righteousness, and make true decisions for the poor.

verses.en: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
verses.pt: Os montes trarão paz ao povo, e os morros trarão justiça.
verses.en_web: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: May the mountains give peace to the people, and the hills righteousness.

verses.en: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
verses.pt: Ele julgará os pobres do povo, livrará os filhos do necessitado, e quebrará o opressor.
verses.en_web: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
verses.en_bbe: May he be a judge of the poor among the people, may he give salvation to the children of those who are in need; by him let the violent be crushed.

verses.en: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
verses.pt: Temerão a ti enquanto durarem o sol e a luz, geração após geração.
verses.en_web: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.
verses.en_bbe: May his life go on as long as the sun and moon, through all generations.

verses.en: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.
verses.pt: Ele descerá como chuva sobre a erva cortada, como as chuvas que regam a terra.
verses.en_web: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
verses.en_bbe: May he come down like rain on the cut grass; like showers watering the earth.

verses.en: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.
verses.pt: Em seus dias o justo florescerá, e haverá abundância de paz, até que não haja mais a lua.
verses.en_web: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.
verses.en_bbe: In his days may the upright do well, living in peace as long as there is a moon in heaven.

verses.en: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.
verses.pt: E ele terá domínio de mar a mar; e desde o rio até os limites da terra.
verses.en_web: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: Let his kingdom be from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

verses.en: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
verses.pt: Os moradores dos desertos se inclinarão perante sua presença, e seus inimigos lamberão o pó da terra.
verses.en_web: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.
verses.en_bbe: Let those who are against him go down before him; and let his haters be low in the dust.

verses.en: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
verses.pt: Os reis de Társis e das ilhas trarão presentes; os reis de Sabá e Seba apresentarão bens.
verses.en_web: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
verses.en_bbe: Let the kings of Tarshish and of the islands come back with offerings; let the kings of Sheba and Seba give of their stores.

verses.en: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
verses.pt: E todos os reis se inclinarão a ele; todas as nações o servirão;
verses.en_web: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
verses.en_bbe: Yes, let all kings go down before him; let all nations be his servants.

verses.en: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.
verses.pt: Porque ele livrará ao necessitado que clamar, e também ao aflito que não tem quem o ajude.
verses.en_web: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
verses.en_bbe: For he will be a saviour to the poor in answer to his cry; and to him who is in need, without a helper.

verses.en: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
verses.pt: Ele será piedoso para o pobre e necessitado, e salvará as almas dos necessitados.
verses.en_web: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.
verses.en_bbe: He will have pity on the poor, and be the saviour of those who are in need.

verses.en: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
verses.pt: Ele livrará suas almas da falsidade e da violência, e o sangue deles lhe será precioso.
verses.en_web: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.
verses.en_bbe: He will keep their souls free from evil designs and violent attacks; and their blood will be of value in his eyes.

verses.en: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.
verses.pt: E ele viverá; e lhe darão ouro de Sabá, e continuamente orarão por ele; o dia todo o bendirão.
verses.en_web: They shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba. Men shall pray for him continually. They shall bless him all day long.
verses.en_bbe: May he have long life, and may gold from Sheba be given to him: may prayers be made for him at all times; may blessings be on him every day.

verses.en: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
verses.pt: Haverá bastante trigo na terra sobre os cumes dos montes; seu fruto brotará como o Líbano; e desde a cidade florescerão como a erva da terra.
verses.en_web: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.
verses.en_bbe: May there be wide-stretching fields of grain in the land, shaking on the top of the mountains, full of fruit like Lebanon: may its stems be unnumbered like the grass of the earth.

verses.en: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
verses.pt: Seu nome permanecerá para sempre; enquanto o sol durar, seu nome continuará; e se bendirão nele; todas as nações o chamarão de bem-aventurado.
verses.en_web: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.
verses.en_bbe: May his name go on for ever, as long as the sun: may men be blessing themselves by him; may all nations be blessing his name.

verses.en: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.
verses.pt: Bendito seja o SENHOR Deus, o Deus de Israel! Somente ele faz tais maravilhas!
verses.en_web: Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
verses.en_bbe: Praise be to the Lord God, the God of Israel, the only doer of wonders.

verses.en: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
verses.pt: E bendito seja seu glorioso nome eternamente; e que sua glória encha toda a terra! Amem, e amém!
verses.en_web: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
verses.en_bbe: Praise to the glory of his noble name for ever; let all the earth be full of his glory. So be it, So be it.

verses.en: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
verses.pt: Aqui terminam as orações de Davi, filho de Jessé. Salmo de Asafe:
verses.en_web: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.
verses.en_bbe: The prayers of David, the son of Jesse, are ended. <A Psalm. Of Asaph.>
